identity_features: 80 MFCC statistics, coefficients 1..20, excluding duration and energy
calibration: sigmoid calibration fitted on validation speakers; test speakers untouched

noise_gate.feature: median voiced-frame spectral flatness, excluding first four FFT bins
noise_gate.selection: Five evenly spaced segments from each training-speaker/target original recording; no validation or test samples.
noise_gate.note: Added after a synthetic noise stress test exposed confident errors. Classifier weights are unchanged; runtime evaluation is rerun.
